facts.text: The hotel sits on a hillside about 15 minutes north of Florence's historic center, with a complimentary shuttle running from 9:30 AM to 9:30 PM.
facts.excerpt: Collegio alla Querce sits on a hillside about 15 minutes north of Florence’s historic center, connected by a complimentary shuttle running from 9:30 AM to 9:30 PM.

facts.text: The Renaissance-era villa became a boarding school before being reimagined as the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Renaissance-era villa has been transformed over time into a boarding school before its latest reimagination into an 83-room hotel

facts.text: The hotel keeps an original chapel and theater.
facts.excerpt: featuring 83 rooms, an original chapel and theater, two restaurants, and a signature bar that was once the principal's office

facts.text: Bar Bertelli occupies the former headmaster's office.
facts.excerpt: Once the office of the headmaster, Bar Bertelli's cocktail program draws on the Collegio alla Querce’s classroom and history museum roots

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites combine high Renaissance art with modern Italian design.
facts.excerpt: combining high Renaissance art with modern Italian design

facts.text: The hotel has a 2,250-square-foot signature Penthouse called la Quercia.
facts.excerpt: the Florentine chic 2,250-square-foot signature Penthouse la Quercia, set within the private Palazzo Moderno

facts.text: Grand Suites include a complimentary minibar with an espresso machine and a signature cocktail on arrival.
facts.excerpt: a complimentary minibar, complete with an espresso machine and locally curated bites and beverages, as well as a signature cocktail upon arrival

facts.text: Grand Suites include a round-trip transfer from or to Florence airport or train station.
facts.excerpt: A round-trip transfer from or to Florence airport or train station is also included

facts.text: Rooms offer personal wine cellars, trunk closets and marble tubs.
facts.excerpt: Personal wine cellars, trunk closets for fully unpacking, marble tubs and invisible technology

facts.text: La Gamella is the signature restaurant, with a seafood-driven approach combined with Tuscan country comforts.
facts.excerpt: the restaurant merges an artful approach to seafood-driven cuisine combined with Tuscan country comforts

facts.text: Il Bosco is a poolside restaurant and bar set among terraced gardens and olive trees.
facts.excerpt: Il Bosco is a relaxed poolside retreat set among terraced gardens and olive trees

facts.text: Bar Bertelli has a cigar room with hand-rolled Italian cigars in the evenings.
facts.excerpt: In the evenings, enjoy hand-rolled Italian cigars in the cigar room

facts.text: Il Bosco Restaurant is open seasonally through September 30.
facts.excerpt: Il Bosco Restaurant is open seasonally through September 30.

facts.text: The Aelia spa operates year-round.
facts.excerpt: The Aelia Spa operates year-round

facts.text: Aelia partners exclusively with Furtuna Skin, which is based on a farm in Sicily.
facts.excerpt: Aelia Exclusively Partners with Furtuna Skin

facts.text: Aelia has a movement studio called Volta Dell'Angelo for mat pilates and yoga.
facts.excerpt: From mat pilates and yoga in our one-of-a-kind movement studio, Volta Dell'Angelo

facts.text: Poolside cabanas hold a maximum of 4 people.
facts.excerpt: Maximum of 4 people

facts.text: A Vivoli gelato cart brings Florentine gelato to the poolside.
facts.excerpt: At Collegio alla Querce a bespoke gelato cart brings this local tradition to the poolside.

facts.text: The pool is open seasonally from April 15 through September 30.
facts.excerpt: open seasonally from April 15 through September 30

facts.text: The pool remains open daily from 9 AM to 7 PM through October 15.
facts.excerpt: The Pool remains open daily from 9 AM to 7 PM through October 15.

facts.text: On-site parking costs EUR 60 per night.
facts.excerpt: Collegio alla Querce offers on-site parking for €60 per night.

facts.text: The hotel is 15 minutes by car from Florence airport.
facts.excerpt: We are 15 minutes by car from Aeroporto di Firenze – Peretola.

facts.text: Experiences include pasta-making classes and after-hours access to the Accademia Gallery.
facts.excerpt: pasta-making classes, after-hours access to the Accademia Gallery, private gallery tours, and Chianti countryside excursions

facts.text: Families can reserve connecting rooms.
facts.excerpt: Reserve a connecting room and save up to 50%

facts.text: The site states the hotel was awarded Three MICHELIN Keys.
facts.excerpt: Awarded Three MICHELIN Keys — The MICHELIN Guide
